Your holdings: SMH (-32.94%), SMCI (-48.45%), and especially leveraged ETFs like SOXL (-85.49%) are bleeding heavily. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. CRWD (+20.54%) is a rare winner, but most of your book is under severe pressure.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further news regarding Big Tech spending and AI investment trends. Also, monitor the political climate around key tech figures like Jensen Huang.

Bottom line: Your heavy concentration in tech/chips, especially leveraged plays, is facing significant headwinds; risk management is paramount.
plays: Respect your stops, especially on leveraged ETFs like SOXL, MUU, and PLTU, where losses are extreme and decay is a factor.
Consider trimming CRWD (+20.54%) to lock in gains and reduce overall portfolio risk, given widespread "SELL" signals elsewhere.
No new buys today - hold and watch. Market sentiment for your core holdings is too negative to initiate new long positions without stronger conviction.
